parameters.jsCode:
const r = $('Filter & Dedupe').first().json;
const s = r.stats;
const lines = [
  `Weekly job scrape — ${r.run_date}`,
  ``,
  `  scraped              ${s.input}`,
  `  duplicates          -${s.duplicate}`,
  `  consulting/ESN      -${s.excluded_company}`,
  `  excluded title      -${s.excluded_title}`,
  `  too old             -${s.too_old}`,
  `  freelance dropped   -${s.freelance_dropped}`,
  `  outside target      -${s.outside_target}`,
  `  ---------------------------`,
  `  KEPT                 ${s.kept}   (${r.target_sector_hits} at target companies)`,
  ``,
  `Saved to Drive: ${r.filename}`,
  ``,
  `Next: ask Claude "score this week's jobs" to rank them,`,
  `then "build a package for <company>" for any you want to pursue.`,
];
return [{ json: { summary: lines.join('\n'), ...s } }];
